args.description: 2D side-view beat 'em up stage background in the style of Streets of Rage 2 and Scott Pilgrim pixel art, flat orthographic side view, horizontal composition. Top 55% of the image: the ground floor of a huge modern Moscow residential high-rise complex: cream-beige ceramic tile facade, vertical protruding bay columns, white stone stylobate with large glass windows. Bottom 45% of the image: a wide empty grey paved sidewalk of square concrete tiles seen slightly from above, receding upward, clean open floor for fighting, no people, no characters. Center: residential entrance door number 3: dark metal door with intercom panel, small concrete canopy over it, three low steps, a blank square plate above the door, a bench and a trash bin beside it, a few green bushes. Late afternoon warm light.
